resources.string: Put cover images where iiSU, Daijishō or another launcher can show them
Write cover images for your games into the folder your launcher reads them from
artwork, box art, boxart, images, media, thumbnails, iisu, daijisho, pegasus, retroarch, emulationstation, launcher, frontend

Valkyr puts one cover per game into a folder you pick, named the way your launcher looks for it: in a sub-folder per console named like your console folders, all in one folder, or arranged as RetroArch, Pegasus or EmulationStation do. The covers come from your RomM server, libretro thumbnails or covers found earlier, and are saved as PNG. Images that are already there are kept unless you choose to replace them.
For any other launcher: pick the folder it reads cover images from, often called media, covers, images or artwork. Its settings or documentation usually say which.
Not sure? Try “%1$s” first: most launchers match covers on the game\'s file name. If your launcher\'s folder already holds covers, pick the layout that looks like them.
For example %1$s. No console folders; games with the same name on two consoles are skipped.
For example %1$s. The libretro thumbnails layout, with your console folder names; characters such as & become _.
For example %1$s. One folder per game, as in the media folder next to a Pegasus metadata file.
For example %1$s. As in EmulationStation\'s gamelist folders: pick the folder that holds your console folders.
%1$s games are skipped because a game of another console would use the same cover file. A layout with console folders keeps them apart.
